text:
ben_support: FYI escalation for Fjordly — activation blocked, SSO token errors + embed quota error. Renewal in 28 days, usage dropped ~40% last week. Sharing logs and what I tried.
asha_success: got it, thanks Ben. can you add the latest support debug log and the customer's preferred contact?
ben_support: pasted log snippet:
```
2024-10-03T14:03Z SSO_ERROR: invalid_assertion
embed: quota_exceeded: limit 5000 -> request 5200
```
ben_support: POC is elaine@fjordly.com; customer is on Standard plan; finance + security are on the renewal call next Tue. I escalated quota request but need CS to drive activation and retention comms.
lucy_csm: taking this — will own handoff. @zara_manager do you want to join the renewal sync? :eyes: 
zara_manager: yes, I'll join. Lucy — can you propose a comms plan + enablement slot for next 48h? we should also capture onboarding feedback for the product team.
lucy_csm: plan draft: 1) 1-hr enablement + SSO walk-through (ASAP), 2) temporary quota bump + fallback plan, 3) post-session checklist + feedback form, 4) renewal pre-read with usage trends. Assigning tasks: lucy_csm -> enablement, ben_support -> logs & dev contact, tom_engineer -> SSO triage. :thumbsup: 
tom_engineer: I'll triage SSO error now, ETA ~4h. if it's an assertion config we'll push a small config fix. will post PR when ready.
ben_support: added dev contact, pushed ticket to priority and attached CSV of failed requests: https://internal/ft/fjordly-fails.csv
lucy_csm: sending customer email template now, FYI:
```
Subject: Quick enablement session and action plan

Hi Elaine,

We noticed a configuration issue blocking SSO and an embedding quota limit. We can schedule a 1-hour walkthrough to get you live before your renewal discussion. Are you available Tues 10am or Wed 2pm?

Regards,
Lucy (Redwood)
```
asha_success: capturing feedback: onboarding doc for SSO (SAML flow) is out of date — logged FEEDBACK-412 for docs team.
lucy_csm: ok scheduled enablement for Wed 2pm. Tom — please post patch before 11am Wed or we postpone. Ben — confirm quota bump status by EOD.
tom_engineer: patch in review, PR #8921 (small config validation fix).
ben_support: quota bump approved for +10% temporarily until renewal call; updated ticket and notified finance.
lucy_csm: perfect. I'll run the session, capture step-by-step notes, and produce a renewal pre-read with usage graphs. tagging ops-bot to create a 'renewal-watch' task.
ops-bot: created task RENEW-774 assigned to lucy_csm, due 2024-11-06
zara_manager: thanks team — let's aim to avoid churn. keep updates here.
lucy_csm: will post post-session notes + customer sentiment summary after Wed. :white_check_mark:
